data: Which model converges at the highest time?

The question asks which model converges at the highest time. From the caption, we know that the time to reach 93% accuracy for each setup is also plotted, and the recursive implementation converges faster for all models. This means that the iterative implementation takes longer to converge than the recursive implementation. 

Looking at the graphs, we can see that the blue line (Iterative) for each model takes longer to reach 93% accuracy compared to the red line (Recursive). Specifically:

- For TreeRNN, the Iterative line takes approximately 1774 seconds to reach 93% accuracy.
- For RNTN, the Iterative line takes approximately 7783 seconds to reach 93% accuracy.
- For TreeLSTM, the Iterative line takes approximately 1870 seconds to reach 93% accuracy.

From this, we can conclude that the RNTN model converges at the highest time.
